notes.title: Update 0.3.0 - Party members
notes.content:
This update introduces an optional playstyle where you control multiple characters at once:
[list]
[*]You can switch between your party members and each one has separate stats, inventory, and spells
[*]You can recruit party members in the lobby by using the Soulforge
[*]You can encounter a "Fellow" in the dungeon who will join you
[/list]

Other changes and fixes:
[list]
[*]Outline shader tweaks
[*]Changed player height
[*]Some UI tweaks
[*]Added lava particles
[*]Fixed boss portraits not rendering correctly in the lobby
[*]Fixed an issue with incorrect controller detection when SteamInput is enabled
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2.1 - UI adjustments
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*]Changed the crafting window layout
[*]Changed stats readout in the character tab
[*]New minimap colors
[*]Labels on the left side of the screen are no longer shown if the inventory is closed
[*]Changed seen objects list colors on the right side of the screen and added arrows
[*]Added a button to sort inventory items
[*]Added a tip for when you need to use a shovel or pickaxe on an object
[*]The new run screen now shows "Undiscovered enemy" for enemies the player has never encountered before
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2.0 - Visuals
notes.content:
In this update, all 39 character models have been replaced with higher-definition versions. This update also brings some other smaller visual tweaks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149277/b0804b78e41d4143ebc0a93479af750c75d62442.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.1.3 - Misc content
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*]Added toxofungus
[*]Added glyphs riddle
[*]Added chain item
[*]Added beer barrel
[*]Added devil statue
[*]Cultists can now remove curse
[*]Some UI adjustments
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.2 - Classes
notes.content:
This update adds classes to the game. 4 classes are available: Rogue, Necromancer, Imposter, and Bogwalker.

Rogue: A nimble and agile fighter focused on mobility and positioning.
Necromancer: A dark magic practitioner who commands undead forces.
Imposter: A master of deception and stealth who can manipulate enemies and escape danger.
Bogwalker: A nature-bound clumsy warrior who harnesses poison and plant magic but fears fire.

notes.title: Update 0.1.1 - Daily challenges
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*]Added daily challenges with leaderboards: Every day, players around the world get to play the same dungeon seed, but you only get one chance per day.
[*]Nerfed archer
[*]Improved lobby shopkeeper cage visibility
[*]Misc tuning and typo fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Ricave is a quirky first-person 3D roguelike dungeon crawler with some fun interactions
notes.content:
Ricave is a thoroughly quirky and unique first-person, 3D roguelike dungeon crawler, now available in Early Access and worth a look.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/06/ricave-is-a-quirky-first-person-3d-roguelike-dungeon-crawler-with-some-fun-interactions/

notes.title: Ricave coming to Early Access on June 2
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We'd like to announce that Ricave is coming to Early Access on June 2, 2025!

Your feedback during this period will shape the journey to version 1.0.

Make sure to add Ricave to your wishlist and thank you for your support!

notes.title: Ricave demo released
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The demo for Ricave was released a week ago, and I'm happy to say that the response has been really great! About 500 people activated the demo on Steam on the very first day, which helped me gather some early feedback. I'd like to thank everyone for your amazing support.

Even though the demo seems to work well already, there's still lots to do. Things like game balance, adding more interesting content, cutting features that don't work well, and overall polishing - all take time. But I believe that the development is currently going in the right direction.

The next goal is to have a polished and fun demo ready for the upcoming Steam Next Fest.

If there's any feature or mechanic you'd like to see in Ricave, please comment below! I'd appreciate any kind of feedback.

Best,
ison
